content: This medication works by reducing the amount of HIV in your body, which allows your immune system to function more effectively. By doing so, it decreases the likelihood of developing HIV-related complications, such as opportunistic infections or certain cancers, and improves your overall quality of life. The product contains four active ingredients: elvitegravir, cobicistat, emtricitabine, and tenofovir. Elvitegravir is classified as an integrase inhibitor, which prevents the virus from integrating its genetic material into your cells. Cobicistat enhances the effectiveness of elvitegravir by slowing its breakdown in the body. However, this combination therapy is not a cure for HIV infection. To minimize the risk of transmitting HIV to others, it is essential to adhere strictly to your prescribed HIV medications. Additionally, use effective barrier methods, such as latex or polyurethane condoms or dental dams, during sexual activity as directed by your healthcare provider. Avoid sharing personal items like needles, syringes, toothbrushes, or razors that may come into contact with blood or bodily fluids. How to Use: Before starting this medication, read the patient information leaflet provided by your pharmacist. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and take the medication exactly as prescribed. Take it at least two hours before or after using other products that may interfere with its effectiveness. For optimal results, take the medication at evenly spaced intervals. Do not alter the dosage or discontinue use without consulting your doctor, even for a short period. Side Effects: Common side effects may include diarrhea, headache, dizziness, difficulty sleeping, unusual dreams, back pain, or changes in the color of the skin on your palms or soles. Remember that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they believe the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. As your immune system strengthens, it may begin to combat pre-existing infections, potentially causing symptoms of those infections to reappear.
